title: Project Aquarius document said to be real

tellings.quote: I've seen the Aquarius document. Alonzo said it was real. People have been saying for years that that was fabricated by Bill Moore uh and Rick Dodie and it turns out no, Alonzo said those guys had nothing to do with anything.

related.note: Both are about the Aquarius document that names MJ-12. Bishop calls it a fake given to Bennewitz, while Davis's source says it was real and that Moore and Doty had nothing to do with it, so only one account can be right.

plain: A paper known as the Aquarius document, said to describe a secret US government UFO project and dated to 1977, is real, according to a man named Alonzo McDonald. The physicist Eric W. Davis, who has worked on government-funded studies of unexplained aerial reports, says he has seen the document himself and that McDonald told him the people long accused of faking it, the UFO writer Bill Moore and a man named Rick Doty, "had nothing to do with anything." If so, it would mean a paper many dismissed as made up came from inside the government.
